After 568 years, the total number of trees will be the initial number of trees plus the net gain per year times the number of years. total_trees = 760 + (30 * 568) = 760 + 17040 = 17800.

The final number of trees is the total number of trees minus the number of trees that die. final_trees = 17800 - 1780 = 16020.
